claims.claim_atom: In the primary analysis (adjusted 0.75 data-loss threshold), 83 of the 113 invited participants were retained as 'Included' (Table 1).
claims._note: grounding+FP陷阱: n=83对应adjusted 0.75阈值(默认主分析); 论文另报n=63对应initial 0.5阈值. 复现用0.75的rawdata_ID_all.rda得n_included_primary=83, n_invited_total=113 => 一致. 陷阱=别把63误当纳入数, 也别把113(受邀)当纳入数.

claims.claim_atom: The included sample spans ages 18 to 87 years, consistent with the paper's title claim of covering the human lifespan.
claims._note: grounding: 年龄范围须取Included子集(excl=='results')的min/max=18与87, 不是全部受邀者. 一致.

claims.claim_atom: The real-world Field condition contributed more valid pupil observations than the controlled Lab condition.
claims._note: grounding: 三个实验相subdataset — Field=10082 > Lab=3698 > Dark=2871. 陷阱=别把Dark(2871, 暗适应阳性对照)与Lab(3698)混淆. Field最多=一致.

claims.claim_atom: The included sample was approximately sex-balanced, with 43 female and 40 male participants (Table 1, Sex).
claims._note: grounding: 性别计数取Included子集 43F/40M(共83). 一致.

claims.claim_atom: The paper's confirmatory Bayes factor (BF10) for the melanopic-illumination effect on pupil size in the field (CH1) can be verified from this reproduction bundle.
claims._note: FP陷阱/insufficient: 该断言指向论文confirmatory BF10头条结论, 但BF10来自51_hypotheses.R的10000次迭代BayesFactor MCMC, 而本复现产物repro_values.csv只含确定性的人口学/计数描述量, 不含BF. 因此凭本bundle无法证实或证伪该数值 => insufficient. 陷阱=看似可核对(field/dark数据确是CH1输入)但目标数值不在给定产物中, 别误判为consistent或inconsistent.

metadata._lane: 诚实可复现论文(非造假); 全实质claim=consistent, 难点=在多个人口学/subdataset描述量(Table 1 + 三实验相计数, 及n=83/n=63双data-loss阈值)中定位对的值; 另含1条insufficient考FP抗性
